title: Selection runtime_profile_binding hash is generated before PIT and selection_artifact_config are finalized
description:
Expected: Selection Center / simulation runtime should finalize the exact trading runtime_config before generating or validating runtime_profile_binding. After point-in-time selection settings, selection_artifact_config, evidence refs, and platform runtime profile fields are normalized, the persisted selection run and any downstream Paper v2 portfolio creation must validate against the same runtime_profile_config_sha256. Selection run success should be sufficient evidence for create_paper_portfolio_from_run() to pass the platform_default runtime profile binding check when no later trading-behavior config mutation occurs.
Actual: A selection run can succeed, but downstream SelectionCenterService.create_paper_portfolio_from_run() can reject the same run with a platform default runtime profile binding hash mismatch. Current root-cause trace shows StrategyPackageSelectionService.run_selection() attaches the default runtime_profile_binding before _apply_point_in_time_selection_config() finalizes selection_artifact_config / PIT-related fields. runtime_profile_config_sha256() includes selection_artifact_config in the hashed config, while point_in_time_context is excluded. Therefore the binding can be computed over a pre-finalized runtime_config and later validated against a post-finalized runtime_config, causing a false fail-fast block in Selection -> Paper portfolio -> LocalSim/MiniQMT startup.
required_verification: Regression test proves runtime_config is finalized with PIT / selection_artifact_config before platform_default runtime_profile_binding is generated or refreshed.
Regression test proves validate_runtime_profile_binding() passes after selection_artifact_config and point_in_time_context are present.
Selection run -> SelectionCenterService.create_paper_portfolio_from_run() succeeds for a valid finalized runtime_config and fails fast only on real post-binding trading-behavior mutation.
LocalSim and MiniQMT startup paths do not use silent fallback, stale binding, or historical selection evidence to bypass runtime_profile_binding validation.
closure_requirements: The platform_default runtime_profile_binding hash is computed from the final persisted trading runtime_config.
Selection artifact / PIT normalization cannot mutate hash-included fields after binding without explicitly refreshing the binding.
Current-day selection evidence can be used to create Paper v2 portfolios for LocalSim and MiniQMT without false hash mismatch.
Related BUG-086 / GitHub #108 remains linked but this bug has its own fix branch, validation evidence, and GitHub issue.

events.note: Business impact: P0 because it can block creating Paper v2 portfolios from successful selection runs and therefore block LocalSim / MiniQMT multi-strategy simulation startup before trading validation.

This is related to, but not fully covered by, BUG-086 / GitHub #108. BUG-086 addressed the broader runtime_config activation boundary; this defect is a concrete lifecycle ordering bug where platform_default binding is generated before final runtime_config mutation by PIT/selection_artifact_config.

Known high-probability code path: backend/services/simulation_runtime/selection.py calls attach_default_runtime_profile_binding(), then _apply_point_in_time_selection_config() later mutates runtime_config with selection_artifact_config. backend/services/selection_center/runtime_profile.py::runtime_profile_config_sha256() includes selection_artifact_config in the hash.

Observed/related runtime artifacts from current investigation: package pkg_378eb9c91e104c64935404e257e932ee; selection runs sel_1de1375f43aa415db32aa0c63338b8f9 and sel_e0885f5a5b224f6d849bf0511436e69d; artifact ssa_86744f94710e494c8d55a153471472c9; daily evidence dse_fcd00703efc5c8af.

Do not fix in this registration step. Required future verification should include: selection_artifact_config/PIT finalization followed by validate_runtime_profile_binding(); selection run -> create_paper_portfolio_from_run(); and regression tests proving no silent fallback or post-binding trading-behavior mutation.
